title: Micro/Nanostructured Materials and Microfluidic Diagnostic Platforms Enable Multimodal Detection of Circulating Tumor Cells.
snippet: Circulating tumor cells (CTCs), as pivotal targets in liquid biopsy, offer dynamic, multidimensional insights into tumor heterogeneity and metastatic progression. title: Molecular, spatial, and AI-enabled technologies for predicting neoadjuvant therapy response in locally advanced rectal cancer.

title: Spatial Atlas of Small Cell Lung Carcinoma Reveals Intratumoral Tumor-State Heterogeneity and an MMP12Macrophage Niche.
snippet: Small-cell lung carcinoma (SCLC) is a highly aggressive tumor with a dismal prognosis among lung cancers. Treatment is failing because of primary or rapidly developing secondary resistance. title: A renal cyst-clear cell renal cell carcinoma comorbidity analysis identifies a FOXM1-positive epithelial COL6A1-CD44 axis that remodels fibroblasts.
snippet: Renal cystic conditions are heterogeneous. We used a broad renal cyst-associated disease-gene framework to identify molecular programs shared with clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC), without modeling a specific cystic disorder or direct cyst-to-cancer progression.
